Verified on-tree: backend/app/main.py has NO static mount today, and no merge_test_index entry asserts one, so nothing regresses — but the Must requirement currently has no owner and no recorded deferral. REMEDY (groom, t24): either (a) add a hermetic ac to t24 wiring StaticFiles + SPA fallback in app/main.py with a TestClient gate (the merged create_app tests build their own route-free apps, so a mount is additive and safe), or (b) record the deferral explicitly in the t24 Requirements line AND in t28's deferral register with the owning phase named. Do not leave the third option (silent disclaimer) — REQ-TECH-042/REQ-CICD-020's own verification texts ('dist copied into the backend image', 'copies the built frontend into static/') ARE satisfied by t24 as written, so only the main.py-mount half is at risk.

Its compose-runs-migrations half is de-facto pinned by ac1 (CMD alembic-upgrade-before-uvicorn) and ac2, so the substance is covered; the gap is the ID-to-AC trace. REMEDY (groom): cite REQ-DB-082 inside ac1/ac2 when pinning commands.

REQ-CICD-035 in t26 is the accepted cross-attestation reference to t24's ac1 (its own Verification is 'Read Dockerfile CMD' — satisfied there). REMEDY (groom): attach the five ids to their owning ACs when pinning.

W4 CITATION-PIN GAP (t27) — REQ-TECH-075 ('Playwright is the E2E tool') appears only in the Requirements line; the substance (the @playwright/test 1.58.0 admission) is pinned in Goal/ac1. REMEDY (groom): cite it in ac1.

W5 THE PINNED TS SYNTAX GATE IS VACUOUS FOR ESM FILES — re-measured on this host (node v24.16.0 at /mnt/d/Program/nodejs/node.exe): `node --experimental-strip-types --check <file>.ts` exits 0 on files containing import/export statements EVEN WHEN THE CODE IS SYNTACTICALLY INVALID (verified: 'import { test } from "@playwright/test";\ntest("flow", async ({ page }) => {\n  await page.goto("/register";' -> rc=0; the same garbage without the import line -> rc=1). With a module marker present, node treats the .ts file as CJS-with-type-stripping and the check silently passes. t27 ac1/ac3 and the t27 Verification constraints therefore rest on a gate that would pass on broken specs — a fail-before-CAPABLE command that is actually vacuous. REMEDY (groom, t27): replace with the measured-working alternative `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --noResolve --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler <file>` (root typescript 5.3.3 is an EXISTING dependency — no new install) gated as 'every reported TS error must have code TS2307 (cannot find module) or TS2580 (process global)', verified working on both a valid and an invalid spec sample; or ship a 3-line ambient stub (declare module '@playwright/test'; declare var process) inside e2e/ and drop --noResolve. Pin the choice at groom with a fail-before demonstration on a deliberately broken fixture under build/.

W6 `npm ci` IN THE e2e TARGET CONTRADICTS THE NO-LOCKFILE RULING — t27 ac4 pins the e2e Makefile target as 'install-isolated: npm ci in e2e/ then npx playwright test', while the Constraints state 'no lockfile commit is required for this milestone (the CI runner installs fresh)'. `npm ci` FAILS HARD without a package-lock.json, so the pinned recipe is self-contradictory in exactly the no-lockfile branch the card sanctions (the CI e2e.yml runner is the only executor, and it would run exactly that command). REMEDY (groom): pick one and pin it — (a) commit e2e/package-lock.json (touches ONLY e2e/; index anchors #17/#55 read frontend/package.json and frontend/src/test/handlers.ts and the root tsconfig include is launcher/extensions/scripts, so a lockfile under e2e/ provably moves no merged gate — verified against all 120 index entries), or (b) pin `npm install --no-save` in the target. Record the reason either way, per the card's own 'groom may rule otherwise only with a recorded reason' clause.

W7 (a) CONTRACT-FIRST HOLE: t28's ac1 fallback-timing leg 'reuses t25's pinned unroutable-URL recipe', but t25 has not yet pinned the fallback accessor/flag NAME that the script must import (ac1 says only 'the fallback decision is exposed to the app (flag/accessor)'). REMEDY (groom, t25 then t28): t25's groom MUST pin the exact symbol and module (e.g. a named function/constant in backend/app/database.py) and t28's groom cites it verbatim — no post-hoc discovery. (b) TIMING MECHANISM UNPINNED: the 5-second bound is only meaningful if the timeout is passed to the DBAPI (psycopg connect_args connect_timeout=5); a bare connect to 127.0.0.1:1 fails in milliseconds via ECONNREFUSED, which would make the '< 5 s' assertion pass without ever proving the timeout chain exists. REMEDY (groom, t25 ac2): pin BOTH legs — a refused-connection case (fast fallback proving the catch) and a connect_timeout-accepted case (the named constant equal to 5 is actually handed to create_engine), with the recorded measured value. (c) t28's script location backend/scripts/infra_verification.py correctly matches the t23 dashboard_verification.py precedent — no finding, recorded here for the Verifier's benefit.

W8 SUITE-FLOOR FORWARD REFERENCES UNPINNED — no card regresses the verified floors (backend >= 230 re-measured: `pytest --collect-only -q` = 230 collected; frontend >= 187 and index >= 120 re-measured: merge_test_index.json has exactly 120 entries with #17=issue t2 and #55=issue t9 confirmed), but t25 ac6 says '>= 230 + new nodes' and t28 ac5 says '>= (230 + t25 new nodes)' — the delta N is an unpinned variable at survey, so the milestone-exit floor is currently circular. REMEDY (groom, t25): pin the exact new-test count alongside the frozen byte-exact titles (t25 ac5 already promises the titles are pinned at groom — pin the count in the same breath); t28's groom then cites the concrete number (230 + N) rather than the expression.

W9 §24.5 CRITERION-11 RANGE IDs REQ-CICD-080..083 UNREGISTERED — the Final Project Criteria table maps criterion 11 (CI/CD) to REQ-CICD-010 to REQ-CICD-083, and the four 08x ids (080 CI provider/parallel/E2E-only-on-main, 081 deploy hook + health verify + migrations-in-CMD, 082 single container/pinned/non-root/UptimeRobot/manual rollback, 083 scans-local-only/secrets-never-in-repo; all Must, verifications 'Read workflows / Dockerfile / README / security/') are cited by NO card and appear in NO register entry. W10 ROLLBACK IDS REQ-CICD-050..053 UNREGISTERED — the survey register's phase_7 boundary names only REQ-OPS-002/020..028/030 and REQ-CICD-061/062 for the ops/ tree, but the rollback requirements REQ-CICD-050/051/052/053 (all verified by 'Read ops/runbook.md') are named nowhere, even though §24.5 criterion 10 spans REQ-CICD-030..062.
